repos_data.description: Geo-related tools PHP 7.3+ library built atop Geocoder and React libraries
Official Geokit Gem. Geokit gem provides geocoding and distance/heading calculations. Pair with the geokit-rails plugin for full-fledged location-based app functionality.

repo_meta_data.description: A concise collection of classes for PHP, Python, JavaScript, Ruby and Go to calculate great circle distance, bearing, and destination from geographic coordinates
